mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200K units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1200K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 6% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200K in a month, the combined signal of a strong labor market leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a quarter, indicating reduced supply chain pressures, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as companies can better manage costs.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP (GDPC1) growth above 3% in a quarter, signaling strong aggregate demand, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors anticipate increased economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 45% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 50 basis points in a month, indicating monetary tightening, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as investors adjust to higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 8% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) decreases by more than 100K in a month, the combined signal of a weakening labor market leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Retail and food services sales (RSAFS) growth above 5% in a month, signaling strong consumer demand, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as investors anticipate sustained economic growth.
evidence_refs: fact:historical retail sales and market correlations
